description_en: Invokes RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider to remove a specified client ID from an OIDC IdP
description_zh: 调用RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider移除OIDC身份提供商中的指定客户端ID
name: RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of an existing OIDC IdP that has the target `ClientId` attached. If you have not created or attached one, call `CreateOIDCProvider` (with `ClientIds` specified) or `AddClientIdToOIDCProvider` first
parameters.help_zh: 已存在且已绑定目标 `ClientId` 的 OIDC 身份提供商名称。如果尚未创建或绑定，可先调用 `CreateOIDCProvider`（设置 `ClientIds`）或 `AddClientIdToOIDCProvider`
parameters.name: oidc_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The client ID to remove.

Format: letters, digits, and the special characters `.-_:/` are allowed. The value cannot start with the special characters `.-_:/`.

Length: up to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh:
指定的客户端ID。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_:/`，不能以特殊字符`.-_:/`开头。

长度：最大128个字符
parameters.name: client_id
